title: Daniel el detective: El caso de la entrada perdida
publisher: TPRS Books (Blaine Ray Workshops); sold by Teacher's Discovery

sources.what: retailer product page: synopsis, level, word counts, tense, glossary, page count, copyright (no chapter list)

summary: A Level 1 comprehensible-input reader set in Spain: Daniel, who dreams of being a detective like Sherlock Holmes, gets a ticket to La Tomatina, the tomato-throwing festival, and wakes to find it gone; he tries to piece together the clues to find it and still go. Written in the present tense with about 150 unique words and 2,500 total words, 54 pages with a glossary and illustrations.
notes: No chapter list was found on any fetched page, so the outline is empty. The school list gives ISBN 9781603724869, but the Teacher's Discovery listing carries ISBN 978-1-60372-181-3 (©2017); the school's copy may be a different printing, not verified. Cultural focus is Spain and La Tomatina (Buñol), with themes of mystery and festivals; suggested for middle and high school.
